title: Supreme Court orders husband's adultery plea to be decided before wife gets interim maintenance
summary: The Supreme Court of India has ruled that a husband's adultery plea must be decided before his wife can receive interim maintenance. The court made this decision in a maintenance case involving a couple. According to the court, if a husband ex facie shows evidence of his wife's adultery, she may not be entitled to interim maintenance. The court's ruling applies to cases where a wife seeks interim maintenance based on her husband's alleged infidelity.
summary_points: The Supreme Court has ordered that a husband's adultery plea must be decided before his wife gets interim maintenance.
If a husband ex facie shows evidence of his wife's adultery, she may not be entitled to interim maintenance.
This ruling applies to cases where a wife seeks interim maintenance based on her husband's alleged infidelity.
title_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने पति की वैवाहिक अनैतिकता याचिका से पहले पत्नी को अस्थायी रखरखाव मांगने के लिए आदेश दिया
summary_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने एक वैवाहिक मामले में पति और पत्नी के बीच अस्थायी रखरखाव मांगने के मामले में आदेश दिया है। अदालत ने यह निर्णय लिया है कि यदि पति स्पष्ट रूप से अपनी पत्नी की वैवाहिक अनैतिकता का प्रमाण दिखाता है, तो वह अस्थायी रखरखाव नहीं मांग सकती। यह निर्णय उन मामलों पर लागू होता है जहाँ पत्नी अपने पति की वैवाहिक अनैतिकता के आधार पर अस्थायी रखरखाव मांगती है।
